title: PROD: TEL - Cascadia
description: Telemetry board: link health, GPS position/status/motion, IMU. Health and faults first, detail below.

panels.title: TEL: Link (s since last frame)
panels.description: Time since the last TELTimeSinceBootup frame reached InfluxDB (looks back 1 h). Red after 3 s: the board, CAN or the radio link is down.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "TELTimeSinceBootup")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: "Last frame", _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
  |> yield(name: "age")

panels.title: TEL: Uptime (s)
panels.description: TELTimeSinceBootUp: seconds since boot. A drop to ~0 means the board reset.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "TELTimeSinceBootup")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "TELTimeSinceBootUp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "last")

panels.title: TEL: MCU Vdd (mV)
panels.description: MCU_Voltage: MCU supply. Red below 2000 mV, where firmware sets the undervoltage flag. 0 means the ADC read failed.

targets.query:

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.title: TEL: Faults
panels.description: TELDiagnostics bits (max per window, so a single faulted frame is never averaged away).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "TELDiagnostics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "TELWatchdogReset" or r["_field"] == "IMUReadFail" or r["_field"] == "IMUWriteFail" or r["_field"] == "GPSReadFail" or r["_field"] == "GPSWriteFail" or r["_field"] == "MCUOvertemp" or r["_field"] == "MCUUndervoltage")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "max")

panels.title: TEL: GPS track
panels.description: GpsLatitude/GpsLongitude (deg). TEL only sends a position when the receiver has a fix.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "TEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "TELGpsPosition")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "GpsLatitude" or r["_field"] == "GpsLongitude")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "GpsLatitude", "GpsLongitude"])
  |> yield(name: "track")
